description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of next token prediction for two distinct experiments, labeled Ex1 Accuracy and Ex2 Accuracy, across a series of training steps. The x-axis, labeled "Step", is linearly scaled from 0 to 60000, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)", is linearly scaled from 0.10 to 0.40, with major gridlines and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The blue line, representing Ex1 Accuracy, begins at a value of approximately 0.235 at step 0, rises sharply to approximately 0.395 at step 10000, and then plateaus near 0.40 from step 20000 to step 60000. The teal line, representing Ex2 Accuracy, starts at 0.09 at step 0, increases to approximately 0.27 at step 10000, then rises further to approximately 0.365 at step 20000, and stabilizes near 0.39 from step 30000 to step 60000. Both lines show an initial increase followed by a plateau, with Ex1 Accuracy consistently higher than Ex2 Accuracy throughout the plotted range.
